# SoulForge — prompt ทีละขั้นของ 8 อาชีพ (v4.1.0)

## ลำดับการทำ
ทำทีละอาชีพตามเลขไฟล์ `01` → `08` แต่ละอาชีพใช้ **1 แชทใหม่** (ChatGPT หรือ Gemini)
1. **ขั้น 0** แนบ `STYLE_ANCHOR.png` แล้ววางข้อความแรก รอ AI ตอบยืนยัน
   **ขั้น 1** ให้ AI สร้างภาพต้นแบบใหม่จากข้อความ เลือกจนพอใจ บันทึกไฟล์ และส่งให้ผมดู
2. **ขั้น 2** ท่ายืน 8 ทิศ (ภาพล็อกทิศ) แล้วไล่ **ขั้น 3 → 9** ในแชทเดียวกัน คัดลอกทีละกล่อง 1 กล่อง = 1 ภาพ = 1 ท่า × 1 ทิศ
   **ขั้น 10 (ใหม่)** สกิลรายตัว: ทุกสกิลรวมท่าไม้ตาย มี **A. ท่าตัวละคร 8 ทิศ** และ **B. ภาพเอฟเฟกต์** — สกิลที่ฟัน/ยิง/พุ่งไปข้างหน้าทำเอฟเฟกต์ 8 ทิศ สกิลวงกลมและบัฟทำ 1 ภาพ · เอฟเฟกต์ใช้พื้นดำล้วน #000000 (เกมบวกแสง สีดำหายเอง) เว้นขอบดำ 15% ทุกด้าน · สกิลที่ขึ้น ✅ มีภาพเอฟเฟกต์ในเกมแล้ว ข้ามส่วน B ได้
3. บันทึกภาพตามชื่อที่เขียนไว้เหนือแต่ละกล่อง ลงโฟลเดอร์ `output\sprites-v4\<อาชีพ>\`
4. ครบแต่ละท่า (8 ภาพ) บอกผมได้เลย ผมจะต่อเข้าเกมและส่งภาพให้ดูก่อน

## กฎทิศของอาวุธ (แก้แล้วในทุกกล่อง)
อาวุธต้องหมุนตามตัวละคร ไม่ว่าจะถือมือซ้ายหรือมือขวา ปลายอาวุธต้องชี้ไปทางเดียวกับที่ตัวละครหัน
ทุกกล่องจึงบอก AI ชัดๆ 3 อย่าง: มือขวาอยู่ฝั่งไหนของภาพในทิศนั้น มือซ้ายอยู่ฝั่งไหน และ "ข้างหน้า" คือทางไหน
| ทิศ | มือขวาอยู่ | มือซ้ายอยู่ | ปลายอาวุธชี้ |
|---|---|---|---|
| S | ซ้ายภาพ | ขวาภาพ | เข้าหากล้อง (ลง) |
| SE | ซ้ายภาพ ด้านหน้า | ขวาภาพ หลังลำตัว | ขวาล่าง |
| E | ด้านหน้าลำตัว | หลังลำตัว | ขวา |
| NE | ขวาภาพ ด้านหน้า | ซ้ายภาพ หลังลำตัว | ขวาบน |
| N | ขวาภาพ | ซ้ายภาพ | ขึ้น (ออกห่างกล้อง) |
| NW | ขวาภาพ หลังลำตัว | ซ้ายภาพ ด้านหน้า | ซ้ายบน |
| W | หลังลำตัว | ด้านหน้าลำตัว | ซ้าย |
| SW | ซ้ายภาพ หลังลำตัว | ขวาภาพ ด้านหน้า | ซ้ายล่าง |

ทิศหันหลัง (N, NE, NW) อาวุธจะถูกลำตัวบังบางส่วน **ถูกต้องแล้ว** ถ้า AI เอาดาบเหวี่ยงออกด้านข้างให้เห็นชัด ให้ตอบ:
`Wrong weapon direction. The weapon must point the same way the character faces (<ทิศ>), partly hidden by the body is fine. Redo.`
ข้อยกเว้นเดียว: Berserker พาดดาบบนบ่า ใบดาบชี้ไปด้านหลัง ด้ามอยู่ด้านหน้า

## กฎรูปทรงอาวุธ (ทุกอาชีพ ทุกกล่อง)
อาวุธ โล่ และของที่ถือ (ดาบ ธนู ไม้เท้า มีด ค้อน คทา หินรูน ลูกแสง) **ต้องเหมือนภาพต้นแบบ 100%** ทุกเฟรมทุกทิศ
ทั้งรูปทรง ความยาว ความกว้าง ความหนา สัดส่วน ความโค้ง ลวดลาย และสี **ห้ามบิด งอ ยืด หด ละลาย หรือเปลี่ยนแบบ**
เปลี่ยนได้อย่างเดียวคือมุมมองตอนหมุน (ดูสั้นลงเมื่อชี้เข้า/ออกจากกล้อง) ดาบตรงต้องตรงเสมอ
ถ้าอาวุธงอหรือเปลี่ยนแบบ ให้ตอบ:
`Weapon shape is wrong. It must be identical to the master reference - rigid and straight, same length and design. Redo.`

## ⭐ กฎสไตล์ตัวละคร (STYLE ANCHOR) — ใช้กับทุกอาชีพ
ภาพแบบ: `output\sprites-v4\master-refs\STYLE_ANCHOR.png` (Paladin ที่คุณเลือก) **แนบภาพนี้ในขั้น 0 ทุกครั้ง** ทุกอาชีพ
ทุกตัวละครต้องเหมือนภาพนี้ในเรื่อง:
- **สัดส่วน:** chibi สูงราว 2.5 หัว (หัว ≈ 40% ของความสูง) chibi กว่าภาพ STYLE ANCHOR หัวใหญ่แต่หน้าผู้ใหญ่เคร่งขรึม ไหล่กว้าง เกราะชิ้นใหญ่ ขาสั้นหนา รองเท้าใหญ่ ยืนกางขามั่นคง เหมือนหุ่นจำลองนักรบ ห้ามผอมหรือน่ารัก
- **หน้า:** ขมวดคิ้ว ตาแคบดูเหนื่อย ใต้ตาคล้ำ ผิวซีด มีแผลเป็น ผมยุ่ง
- **ลายเนื้อ:** วาดละเอียดทุกพื้นผิว โลหะตีขึ้นรูปมีรอยบุบและสนิม ผ้าขาดรุ่ย หนังแตก มีเส้นขอบเข้ม
- **แสงและสี:** แสงอุ่นสลัวจากซ้ายบน เงาน้ำตาลเกือบดำ สีหม่น ได้แก่ บรอนซ์หมอง เหล็กตะกั่ว แดงเลือดแห้ง และขาวกระดาษเก่า
- **รายละเอียดสยองศักดิ์สิทธิ์:** แถบกระดาษผนึกครั่งแดง โซ่ ไม้กางเขน/เครื่องรางของอาชีพ ตะเกียงแขวน ใบหน้าวิญญาณสลักบนอุปกรณ์
อาชีพอื่นใช้ภาพนี้เป็น **แบบสไตล์เท่านั้น** ห้ามลอกชุด สี หรืออาวุธ (ใน prompt สั่งไว้แล้ว)

## ✋ กฎการถืออาวุธ (เพื่อทำท่าเคลื่อนไหวได้สะอาด)
อาวุธ โล่ และของที่ถือต้อง**ห่างจากตัว** แขนกางออกราว 30–45° ต้องเห็นช่องว่างระหว่างอาวุธกับลำตัว ขา และหน้า
ห้ามดาบหรือด้ามแนบลำตัว พาดทับหน้าอกหรือแขนอีกข้างในท่ายืนและเดิน โล่ถือยื่นออกมาเล็กน้อย ไม่แนบอก
(Berserker พาดดาบบนบ่าได้ แต่มือและด้ามไม่แนบหน้าอก)
ถ้าอาวุธชิดตัว ให้ตอบ: `Weapon is glued to the body. Redo with the arm reaching out and clear empty space between the weapon and the body.`

## ⛔ กฎขนาดและรูปแบบไฟล์ (ห้ามละเมิด)
- **1 ภาพ = 1 ท่า × 1 ทิศ เท่านั้น** ห้ามรวมหลายทิศหรือหลายท่าในภาพเดียว
- **จำนวนช่องต้องตรงตามกล่องเป๊ะ** เช่น 4×2 = 8 เฟรม ห้ามมากหรือน้อยกว่า **ห้ามตาราง 8×8** (8 ทิศ × 8 เฟรมในภาพเดียว)
- **ขนาดภาพต้องตรงตามกล่อง** 1536×1024 หรือ 1024×1024 เท่านั้น
- **ระยะห่างทุกด้าน 2 เท่า:** ทุกตัวมีที่ว่างรอบตัว**ทั้ง 4 ด้าน** (บน ล่าง ซ้าย ขวา) อย่างน้อย 20% ของช่อง ระยะห่างระหว่างตัวที่อยู่ติดกันต้องอย่างน้อย 40% ของความกว้างช่อง (**2 เท่าของขอบ**) ห้ามดาบ โล่ ผ้าคลุม ปีก หรือผมแตะกัน ซ้อนกัน หรือล้นขอบ ตัวละครสูงราว 55–60% ของช่อง
- **ไม่มีพื้นหลัง (โปร่งใสทั้งหมด)** ห้ามสีพื้น ห้ามไล่สี ห้ามพื้นน้ำตาล/เทา/ขาว ห้ามลายตารางหมากรุก ห้ามพื้น เงา หมอก หรือฉาก
- ภาพที่ผิดกฎข้อใดข้อหนึ่ง **ห้ามบันทึกและห้ามส่งให้ผม** ให้สั่งเจนใหม่ด้วยประโยคนี้:
```text
Wrong format. This breaks the hard rule. Redo: ONE direction only, exactly the grid I asked for (e.g. 4 columns x 2 rows = 8 frames), exactly 1536x1024, empty space of at least 20% of the cell on all four sides of every figure and gaps between figures at least TWICE that, figures never touch or overlap, fully transparent background (no color, no gradient, no checkerboard). No other directions.
```

## ทำไมได้หลายไฟล์ และเรื่องพื้นหลัง
- **1 ไฟล์ = 1 ท่า × 1 ทิศ (8 เฟรม)** ตั้งใจแบบนี้ ถ้ารวม 8 ทิศ × 8 เฟรม = 64 ท่าในภาพเดียว 1536×1024 ตัวละครจะเหลือแค่ราว 190×128 px ต่อท่า AI จะวาดหน้าตา อาวุธ และทิศเพี้ยนจนใช้ไม่ได้
- **ในเกมจะเป็นไฟล์เดียว:** พอส่งครบ 8 ทิศ ระบบของผมรวมเป็นชีตเดียวต่อท่าให้อัตโนมัติ (และรวมทุกท่าเป็นชุดเดียวต่ออาชีพ)
- **พื้นหลัง:** ทุกกล่องสั่งให้ **โปร่งใส (ไม่มีพื้นหลัง)** ใน ChatGPT ใช้ได้ ส่วน Gemini ทำโปร่งใสไม่ได้ จะใช้สีม่วงชมพูล้วนแทน ระบบผมลบสีนั้นออกให้เป็นโปร่งใสเอง
- ถ้า ChatGPT วาดลายตารางหมากรุกมาให้ (โปร่งใสปลอม) ให้ใช้ประโยคแก้ด้านล่าง

ลำดับท่าเรียงตามความสำคัญ: เดิน → ตาย → โดนตี → ยืน → โจมตี → สกิล → บัฟ
ถ้าเวลาน้อย ทำแค่ **ขั้น 1 (ต้นแบบ) + ขั้น 2 (ยืน 8 ทิศ) + ขั้น 3 (เดิน)** ของทุกอาชีพก่อน จะแก้อาการเดินกระตุกได้ทั้งเกม

## ตั้งค่าขนาดภาพ
- ChatGPT: กล่องที่เขียน `1536x1024 landscape` เลือก **Landscape**; `1024x1024 square` เลือก **Square**
- Gemini: ใช้ข้อความในกล่องได้เลย ถ้าได้อัตราส่วนผิด ให้ตอบว่า "regenerate at exactly 1536x1024"

## ถ้าภาพออกมาสว่าง/น่ารัก/เหมือนอนิเมะเกินไป (ไม่ดาร์ค)
ตอบในแชทเดิมด้วยข้อความนี้ (ใช้ได้ทุกอาชีพ):
```text
Too bright and too cute. Redo the same design in a much darker grimdark style:
- low-key lighting, most of the body in deep shadow, only top-left edges lit
- desaturate all colors by about 40%; tarnished antique gold instead of bright gold; dull scratched gunmetal instead of shiny silver; darker, dirtier cloth
- add wear: scratches, dents, soot, mud on boots and hem, frayed cloth edges
- grim battle-hardened face: narrower eyes, heavy brows, no sparkle, no cute expression
- heavy painterly brushwork, strong light-dark contrast, like Diablo / Darkest Dungeon art
Keep the same design, outfit, headwear, cloak, weapon and shield shapes, and the same 3-view layout.
```
ถ้ายังสว่างอยู่ ส่งซ้ำพร้อมเพิ่มบรรทัด `Even darker. Overall image value should be mostly dark midtones.`

## ถ้าภาพผิด ให้ตอบกลับด้วยประโยคเหล่านี้ (เจนใหม่ อย่าแก้ด้วยการกลับภาพ)
- มือสลับ: `Wrong hands. Redo: the weapon must be in the character's RIGHT hand as in the master reference.`
- ทิศผิด: `Wrong direction. Redo facing <ทิศตามกล่อง>.`
- หน้าตาเพี้ยน: แนบไฟล์ต้นแบบที่บันทึกไว้ + `Match this master reference exactly. Redo.`
- มีพื้นหลัง/พื้น/เงา/ตัวหนังสือ: `No background. Redo with a real transparent background (PNG alpha) - no backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow, no text.`
- ถ้าได้ลายตารางหมากรุกขาว-เทาติดมาในภาพ (โปร่งใสปลอม): `That checkerboard is painted, not transparent. Redo with real transparency; if you cannot, use a flat solid #FF00FF background instead.`
- อาวุธชี้ผิดทาง/เหวี่ยงออกข้าง: `Wrong weapon direction. The weapon must point the same way the character faces, partly hidden by the body is fine. Redo.`
- อาวุธงอ/บิด/เปลี่ยนแบบ: `Weapon shape is wrong. It must be identical to the master reference - rigid and straight, same length and design. Redo.`
- จำนวนช่องผิด: `Wrong grid. Redo with exactly <จำนวน> equal cells.`

## ชุดบังคับของแต่ละอาชีพ (ปรับรอบนี้)
| อาชีพ | ผ้าคลุม | หมวก/ของสวมหัว | เปลี่ยนจากแบบเดิม |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paladin | ผ้าคลุมยาวสีแดงเลือดหมู ขาดรุ่ย ลายกางเขน | หมวกเหล็กเปิดหน้า มีปีกนกสองข้าง | **ใช่** (โล่มีปีกสยายด้านบน ดาบมีปีกที่โกร่ง) |
| Berserker | ผ้าคลุมหนังขนหมาป่าสีน้ำตาลเข้ม | หมวกเหล็กดำมีเขาโค้ง | **ใช่** |
| Assassin | ผ้าคลุมสั้นสีดำซับม่วง ชายขาด | ฮู้ด + ผ้าปิดหน้า (ของเดิม) | **ใช่** |
| Hawkeye | ผ้าคลุมเขียว (ของเดิม) | ฮู้ด (ของเดิม) | ไม่เปลี่ยน |
| HighPriest | — | หมวกไมเตอร์ (หมวกบิชอป) ขาว-ทอง | **ใช่** |
| Inquisitor | — | หมวกปีกกว้าง (ของเดิม) | ไม่เปลี่ยน |
| Elementalist | — | ไม่มี (ตามที่กำหนด) | ไม่เปลี่ยน |
| RuneMaster | — | ไม่มี (ตามที่กำหนด) | ไม่เปลี่ยน |

ทุกอาชีพสร้างต้นแบบใหม่ในขั้น 1 (แนบแค่ `STYLE_ANCHOR.png` ในขั้น 0) **ไม่ต้องแนบไฟล์ต้นแบบเดิม** (ไฟล์ใน `master-refs` ที่ไม่มี `_v2` เป็นของเก่า ไม่ต้องใช้แล้ว)
ชีตเก่าในเกมจะถูกแทนด้วยชุดใหม่ทั้งหมด จึงต้องเจนครบทุกท่าของทุกอาชีพ

คำอธิบายหน้าตายังตามภาพในเกมเป็นหลัก: HighPriest ถือลูกแสง (ไม่ใช่คัมภีร์) และ Berserker เปลือยท่อนบน

# 1. Paladin — พาลาดิน · prompt ทีละขั้น (ชาย)

ต้นแบบ: สร้างใหม่ใน**ขั้น 1** (แนบแค่ `STYLE_ANCHOR.png` ในขั้น 0) · **ไม่มีพื้นหลัง (โปร่งใส)** — สำรอง #FF00FF

บันทึกไฟล์ที่: `output\sprites-v4\paladin\` · ต้นแบบบันทึกที่ `output\sprites-v4\master-refs\Paladin_male_master_ref_v2.png`

> ทำทุกขั้นใน **แชทเดียวกัน** · ไฟล์เดียวที่ต้องแนบคือ **`master-refs\STYLE_ANCHOR.png`** ในขั้น 0 (ภาพแบบสไตล์/โทนของทั้งเกม) ต้นแบบที่ AI สร้างในขั้น 1 จะอยู่ในแชทนั้น ทุกกล่องหลังจากนั้นอ้างถึงภาพนี้เอง

## ขั้น 0 — เปิดแชทใหม่ แนบ `STYLE_ANCHOR.png` แล้ววางข้อความนี้

```text
You are producing game sprite art for "SoulForge", a 2.5D dark-fantasy MMORPG. Follow these rules in EVERY image of this chat:

STYLE: DARK FANTASY / GRIMDARK hand-painted game art - NOT bright, NOT cute, NOT anime gacha, NOT glossy mobile-game style.
STYLE ANCHOR (the fixed look of the whole game; if a STYLE ANCHOR image is attached, match its style, rendering and tone (but use the more chibi proportions below) - but NOT its design, unless this chat is for that same character):
  - Proportions: CHIBI, about 2.5 heads tall (the head is about 40% of the total height) - MORE chibi than the STYLE ANCHOR image. Big head with a MATURE, grim adult face (never a baby face, never big sparkly eyes). Short compact torso, short thick arms and legs, oversized hands, boots, pauldrons and armor plates, wide grounded stance. Cute proportions, dark and serious mood.
  - Face: stern frown, narrow tired eyes with dark shadows under them, heavy brows, pale ashen skin, battle scars (for example a scar across one eye), messy hair.
  - Rendering: highly detailed hand-painted texture on every surface - hammered and pitted metal, rust spots, grime, frayed torn cloth, worn cracked leather, visible fine brushwork, crisp dark outline on the silhouette.
  - Lighting: dim warm light from the top-left, deep brown-black shadows, strong light/dark contrast; glow only on small holy or magic accents.
  - Palette: desaturated and dirty - tarnished bronze and antique gold, dark gunmetal steel, oxblood / dried-blood red cloth, bone-white aged parchment, dark leather browns. Never saturated, never bright.
  - Macabre relic details: torn parchment strips with red wax seals, chains, small crosses or class relics, a hanging lantern or charm, ghostly faces or motifs carved into gear - age, decay and sacrifice in every piece.
DARK & HAUNTED TONE (mandatory for EVERY image in this game - characters, monsters, bosses, NPCs, items, maps):
  - Low-key lighting: most of the figure sits in dark midtones and deep, almost black shadows; only the top-left lit edges and a few focal points (face, emblem, magic glow) are bright.
  - Muted, desaturated, dirty colors: tarnished antique gold (never bright yellow gold), dull scratched gunmetal steel (never shiny chrome), dark faded cloth, worn leather.
  - Wear and grime: scratches, dents, chipped edges, soot, mud on boots and hems, frayed and torn cloth edges.
  - Serious, grim, battle-hardened faces: smaller narrow eyes with heavy brows, no big sparkling anime eyes, no blush, no cute smile.
  - Heavy painterly brushwork with strong contrast between light and shadow.
  - HAUNTED, eerie undertone: a cold, sickly pale-teal or ghostly-green rim light on the shadow side; pale, slightly ashen skin; shadowed hollow eye areas; a quiet sense of dread.
  - Small macabre details that fit the class or creature: bone charms, skull motifs, chains, wax seals and dripping candle wax, stitched scars, cracked runes, torn prayer cloth, faint ghostly wisps clinging to cloth edges (on the figure only, never on the background).
  - Heroes are grim survivors in a cursed world - dark and haunted, but still heroic and readable, never gory.
CAMERA: fixed 3/4 top-down view, about 30 degrees above the horizon, orthographic (no perspective distortion). Same camera in every image.
LIGHT: key light from the TOP-LEFT of the image, warm; faint cool rim light on the right. NO cast shadow on the ground.
BACKGROUND: NO BACKGROUND. Output a PNG with a real TRANSPARENT background (alpha channel): only the character/object is visible, everything else is empty transparency.
  Never paint a checkerboard pattern, a white or grey backdrop, a floor, a ground shadow, a vignette or any scenery to "show" transparency.
  (Only if you are unable to output real transparency, use a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta instead - for purple characters #00FF00 green - with nothing else on it.)
FORBIDDEN: text, numbers, labels, grid lines, frames, borders, watermarks, UI, scenery, ground plane, more than one character per cell, mirrored copies.
OUTPUT FORMAT IS A HARD RULE (never break it):
  - ONE image = ONE action in ONE direction only. Never put several directions, several actions or a turnaround in the same image.
  - The image contains EXACTLY the number of frames and the exact grid I ask for (e.g. 4 columns x 2 rows = 8 frames) - never more cells, never fewer, never an 8x8 or any other grid.
  - The image is EXACTLY the size I ask for (1536x1024 or 1024x1024).
  - SPACING: every figure stands alone in its own cell with EMPTY transparent space on ALL FOUR SIDES (top, bottom, left, right) of at least 20% of the cell; so the empty gap between two neighbouring figures is at least 40% of a cell width - TWICE the edge margin. Figures (including weapon, shield, cloak, wings and hair) never touch, never overlap and are never cut by the cell or image edge. Character height about 55-60% of the cell height.
  - NO BACKGROUND: the background is fully TRANSPARENT (PNG alpha). No color, no gradient, no brown/grey/white backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow, no fog, no scenery.
  - If anything I ask would break these rules, do NOT draw - ask me instead.
SPRITE SHEETS: exactly the grid I ask for, equal cells, ONE pose per cell, the whole body and weapon fully inside each cell with empty space around it,
  same character size and the same feet position in every cell, feet near the bottom of each cell.
CONSISTENCY: the master reference you create in this chat is the law — same face, hair, armor pieces, colors, patterns, weapon shape and size. Never redesign.
HANDS: left/right always means the CHARACTER'S own left/right, not the image's. Never swap the hands of the weapon/shield/focus in any direction.
DIRECTIONS (image left/right):
  S = facing the camera, front view
  SE = three-quarter front, body turned toward the RIGHT side of the image
  E = full side profile facing the RIGHT edge of the image
  NE = three-quarter back view, facing away toward the upper RIGHT
  N = back view, facing away from the camera
  NW = three-quarter back view, facing away toward the upper LEFT
  W = full side profile facing the LEFT edge of the image
  SW = three-quarter front, body turned toward the LEFT side of the image
Back views (N, NE, NW) must show the real back: cape, back of helmet/hood, weapon seen from behind.
WEAPON HOLD (for clean animation): weapons, shields and focus items are held clearly AWAY from the body - the arm reaches out about 30-45 degrees, leaving visible empty space between the item and the torso, legs and face. The blade/shaft never lies flat against the body or crosses over the torso, face or the other arm in idle and walk; a shield is held slightly forward with a small gap, not glued to the chest. Body and weapon must read as two separate shapes in every direction and every frame.
WEAPON FOLLOWS THE BODY: weapons, shields and focus items turn together with the character. Whatever the direction, the weapon stays in the same hand and its tip/head points the same way the character is facing (unless the class rule says otherwise).
  In back views (N, NE, NW) the weapon in front of the body may be partly hidden by the body or seen from behind - that is correct. Never swing it out sideways or flip it to the other side just to make it visible.
WEAPON SHAPE IS FIXED: every weapon, shield and focus item is a rigid object that must match the master reference 100% in every frame and every direction - same shape, length, width, thickness, proportions, curve, details and colors. Blades, staffs, bows, hammers and shields NEVER bend, warp, wobble, melt, stretch, shrink, thicken, split or change design. Only perspective may change as the object turns (foreshortening), never its real shape. A straight blade stays perfectly straight.

The attached image is the STYLE ANCHOR of the whole game: match its face style, rendering, lighting, palette and grimdark tone exactly, but make the body MORE CHIBI than the anchor (about 2.5 heads tall). It is also this same character (Paladin) - keep its design and add the items listed in LOOK.

CHARACTER FOR THIS CHAT: Paladin (male), player class.
LOOK: Grim chibi holy knight (crusader paladin). Messy shoulder-length ash-blond hair, pale ashen skin, stern frowning face with narrow tired eyes, dark shadows under the eyes and a red scar across the left eye. Open-face hammered dark-steel helmet with tarnished bronze trim and a pair of ash-grey, dull-silver bird wings spreading from BOTH sides (the face and the front of the hair stay visible). Heavy hammered gunmetal plate armor with tarnished bronze trim, huge rounded pauldrons with bronze crosses and ash-grey wing engravings, chainmail at the neck with a bronze chain and cross pendant. Torn bone-white parchment tabard with a dried-blood red cross, torn parchment strips with red wax seals hanging from the chest, dark leather belt with pouches and a small bronze lantern hanging at the hip. Long tattered oxblood-red cape with a pale cross on it, ragged hem. Heater/kite shield of hammered steel with tarnished bronze rim, a bronze cross, a carved ghostly saint face, red wax seals with parchment strips, and a pair of spread ash-grey wings rising from the TOP edge of the shield. Heavy straight broad longsword with a pitted dark-steel blade and a tarnished bronze WINGED crossguard (two small metal wings spread sideways between the blade and the grip), leather-wrapped grip.
DARK PALETTE: hammered gunmetal steel, tarnished bronze, oxblood-red cape, bone-white aged parchment with dried-blood red crosses, dark leather; ash-grey wings; no bright colors, only a faint warm glint on the bronze.
HAND RULE: longsword with the winged crossguard in the character's RIGHT hand; winged kite shield on the character's LEFT arm. Never swap them in any direction.
DEFAULT POSE: shield held upright at the left side (face of the shield vertical, never flat), sword lowered forward-down at the right side. Arms reach out so the weapon and any shield/focus stay clear of the body with visible space between them.
Do not draw anything yet. Reply only with a short confirmation that you understand the character and the rules.
```

## ขั้น 10 — สกิลรายตัว (ท่าของแต่ละสกิล + ภาพเอฟเฟกต์)

แต่ละสกิลมี 2 ส่วน: **A. ท่าตัวละคร** 8 ภาพ (1 ภาพ = 1 ทิศ) และ **B. ภาพเอฟเฟกต์** (สกิลที่พุ่ง/ฟันไปข้างหน้าทำ 8 ทิศ · สกิลวงกลม/บัฟทำ 1 ภาพ)

> เอฟเฟกต์ใช้ **พื้นดำล้วน #000000** (ไม่ใช่โปร่งใส) เพราะเกมนำไปบวกแสง สีดำจะหายไปเอง และต้องเว้นขอบดำ 15% ทุกด้าน ไม่ให้เห็นกรอบสี่เหลี่ยม

## ขั้น 0 — เปิดแชทใหม่ แนบ `STYLE_ANCHOR.png` แล้ววางข้อความนี้

```text
You are producing game sprite art for "SoulForge", a 2.5D dark-fantasy MMORPG. Follow these rules in EVERY image of this chat:

STYLE: DARK FANTASY / GRIMDARK hand-painted game art - NOT bright, NOT cute, NOT anime gacha, NOT glossy mobile-game style.
STYLE ANCHOR (the fixed look of the whole game; if a STYLE ANCHOR image is attached, match its style, rendering and tone (but use the more chibi proportions below) - but NOT its design, unless this chat is for that same character):
  - Proportions: CHIBI, about 2.5 heads tall (the head is about 40% of the total height) - MORE chibi than the STYLE ANCHOR image. Big head with a MATURE, grim adult face (never a baby face, never big sparkly eyes). Short compact torso, short thick arms and legs, oversized hands, boots, pauldrons and armor plates, wide grounded stance. Cute proportions, dark and serious mood.
  - Face: stern frown, narrow tired eyes with dark shadows under them, heavy brows, pale ashen skin, battle scars (for example a scar across one eye), messy hair.
  - Rendering: highly detailed hand-painted texture on every surface - hammered and pitted metal, rust spots, grime, frayed torn cloth, worn cracked leather, visible fine brushwork, crisp dark outline on the silhouette.
  - Lighting: dim warm light from the top-left, deep brown-black shadows, strong light/dark contrast; glow only on small holy or magic accents.
  - Palette: desaturated and dirty - tarnished bronze and antique gold, dark gunmetal steel, oxblood / dried-blood red cloth, bone-white aged parchment, dark leather browns. Never saturated, never bright.
  - Macabre relic details: torn parchment strips with red wax seals, chains, small crosses or class relics, a hanging lantern or charm, ghostly faces or motifs carved into gear - age, decay and sacrifice in every piece.
DARK & HAUNTED TONE (mandatory for EVERY image in this game - characters, monsters, bosses, NPCs, items, maps):
  - Low-key lighting: most of the figure sits in dark midtones and deep, almost black shadows; only the top-left lit edges and a few focal points (face, emblem, magic glow) are bright.
  - Muted, desaturated, dirty colors: tarnished antique gold (never bright yellow gold), dull scratched gunmetal steel (never shiny chrome), dark faded cloth, worn leather.
  - Wear and grime: scratches, dents, chipped edges, soot, mud on boots and hems, frayed and torn cloth edges.
  - Serious, grim, battle-hardened faces: smaller narrow eyes with heavy brows, no big sparkling anime eyes, no blush, no cute smile.
  - Heavy painterly brushwork with strong contrast between light and shadow.
  - HAUNTED, eerie undertone: a cold, sickly pale-teal or ghostly-green rim light on the shadow side; pale, slightly ashen skin; shadowed hollow eye areas; a quiet sense of dread.
  - Small macabre details that fit the class or creature: bone charms, skull motifs, chains, wax seals and dripping candle wax, stitched scars, cracked runes, torn prayer cloth, faint ghostly wisps clinging to cloth edges (on the figure only, never on the background).
  - Heroes are grim survivors in a cursed world - dark and haunted, but still heroic and readable, never gory.
CAMERA: fixed 3/4 top-down view, about 30 degrees above the horizon, orthographic (no perspective distortion). Same camera in every image.
LIGHT: key light from the TOP-LEFT of the image, warm; faint cool rim light on the right. NO cast shadow on the ground.
BACKGROUND: NO BACKGROUND. Output a PNG with a real TRANSPARENT background (alpha channel): only the character/object is visible, everything else is empty transparency.
  Never paint a checkerboard pattern, a white or grey backdrop, a floor, a ground shadow, a vignette or any scenery to "show" transparency.
  (Only if you are unable to output real transparency, use a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta instead - for purple characters #00FF00 green - with nothing else on it.)
FORBIDDEN: text, numbers, labels, grid lines, frames, borders, watermarks, UI, scenery, ground plane, more than one character per cell, mirrored copies.
OUTPUT FORMAT IS A HARD RULE (never break it):
  - ONE image = ONE action in ONE direction only. Never put several directions, several actions or a turnaround in the same image.
  - The image contains EXACTLY the number of frames and the exact grid I ask for (e.g. 4 columns x 2 rows = 8 frames) - never more cells, never fewer, never an 8x8 or any other grid.
  - The image is EXACTLY the size I ask for (1536x1024 or 1024x1024).
  - SPACING: every figure stands alone in its own cell with EMPTY transparent space on ALL FOUR SIDES (top, bottom, left, right) of at least 20% of the cell; so the empty gap between two neighbouring figures is at least 40% of a cell width - TWICE the edge margin. Figures (including weapon, shield, cloak, wings and hair) never touch, never overlap and are never cut by the cell or image edge. Character height about 55-60% of the cell height.
  - NO BACKGROUND: the background is fully TRANSPARENT (PNG alpha). No color, no gradient, no brown/grey/white backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow, no fog, no scenery.
  - If anything I ask would break these rules, do NOT draw - ask me instead.
SPRITE SHEETS: exactly the grid I ask for, equal cells, ONE pose per cell, the whole body and weapon fully inside each cell with empty space around it,
  same character size and the same feet position in every cell, feet near the bottom of each cell.
CONSISTENCY: the master reference you create in this chat is the law — same face, hair, armor pieces, colors, patterns, weapon shape and size. Never redesign.
HANDS: left/right always means the CHARACTER'S own left/right, not the image's. Never swap the hands of the weapon/shield/focus in any direction.
DIRECTIONS (image left/right):
  S = facing the camera, front view
  SE = three-quarter front, body turned toward the RIGHT side of the image
  E = full side profile facing the RIGHT edge of the image
  NE = three-quarter back view, facing away toward the upper RIGHT
  N = back view, facing away from the camera
  NW = three-quarter back view, facing away toward the upper LEFT
  W = full side profile facing the LEFT edge of the image
  SW = three-quarter front, body turned toward the LEFT side of the image
Back views (N, NE, NW) must show the real back: cape, back of helmet/hood, weapon seen from behind.
WEAPON HOLD (for clean animation): weapons, shields and focus items are held clearly AWAY from the body - the arm reaches out about 30-45 degrees, leaving visible empty space between the item and the torso, legs and face. The blade/shaft never lies flat against the body or crosses over the torso, face or the other arm in idle and walk; a shield is held slightly forward with a small gap, not glued to the chest. Body and weapon must read as two separate shapes in every direction and every frame.
WEAPON FOLLOWS THE BODY: weapons, shields and focus items turn together with the character. Whatever the direction, the weapon stays in the same hand and its tip/head points the same way the character is facing (unless the class rule says otherwise).
  In back views (N, NE, NW) the weapon in front of the body may be partly hidden by the body or seen from behind - that is correct. Never swing it out sideways or flip it to the other side just to make it visible.
WEAPON SHAPE IS FIXED: every weapon, shield and focus item is a rigid object that must match the master reference 100% in every frame and every direction - same shape, length, width, thickness, proportions, curve, details and colors. Blades, staffs, bows, hammers and shields NEVER bend, warp, wobble, melt, stretch, shrink, thicken, split or change design. Only perspective may change as the object turns (foreshortening), never its real shape. A straight blade stays perfectly straight.

The attached image is the STYLE ANCHOR of the whole game: match its face style, rendering, lighting, palette and grimdark tone exactly, but make the body MORE CHIBI than the anchor (about 2.5 heads tall). Do NOT copy its design, armor, colors or weapons - this chat is for a different character.

LOOK: Grim chibi ranger with a dark forest-green hood pulled over brown hair, long ragged green cloak, brown leather tunic with straps and belt, leather bracers, tall brown boots, a quiver full of arrows on the back.
DARK PALETTE: dark moss green and near-black olive cloth, dark worn brown leather, dull bronze buckles, mud on boots and cloak hem.
HAND RULE: wooden longbow always in the character's LEFT hand; the RIGHT hand draws arrows from the quiver and pulls the string. Never swap.
DEFAULT POSE: bow held low in the left hand tilted about 45 degrees downward toward the front, right hand relaxed near the hip. Arms reach out so the weapon and any shield/focus stay clear of the body with visible space between them.
```

**2.1 ทิศ S** → บันทึกเป็น `hawkeye_male_stand_S_raw_v1.png`

```text
Using the approved MASTER REFERENCE of Hawkeye (male) from earlier in this chat:
Draw the DEFAULT STANDING POSE (one still idle frame) facing direction S (facing the camera, front view).
Do NOT invent anything: follow every rule already given in this chat - STYLE ANCHOR, chibi proportions, DARK & HAUNTED tone, HANDS, WEAPON HOLD, WEAPON FOLLOWS THE BODY, WEAPON SHAPE IS FIXED, the DIRECTIONS table, OUTPUT FORMAT and NO BACKGROUND. Same design, colours, headwear, cloak, weapon and shield shapes and the same body size as the master reference.
HARD RULE: ONE character only, facing ONLY direction S. No other views, no turnaround, no extra figures. Image exactly 1024x1024 square.
SPACING (hard rule): character height about 55-60% of the image, horizontally centred, feet at about 85% of the image height, at least 20% empty transparent space on all four sides; nothing cut by the edge.
NO BACKGROUND (hard rule): fully TRANSPARENT (PNG alpha) - no colour, gradient, checkerboard, floor, shadow or fog.
Pose: bow held low in the left hand tilted about 45 degrees downward toward the front, right hand relaxed near the hip. Arms reach out so the weapon and any shield/focus stay clear of the body with visible space between them.
Hands: wooden longbow always in the character's LEFT hand; the RIGHT hand draws arrows from the quiver and pulls the string. Never swap. Do not mirror.
In direction S the character's RIGHT hand is on the IMAGE LEFT and the LEFT hand is on the IMAGE RIGHT; forward is toward the camera (down in the image).
Weapon direction: the LEFT hand holds the bow out in front, angled toward the camera (down in the image); when an arrow is drawn it points toward the camera (down in the image). The weapon turns with the body and keeps a clear gap from it (arm reaching out, never glued to the torso or legs) - but never swing it out sideways away from the facing direction and never switch sides.
Weapon shape: identical to the master reference 100% - rigid, never bent, warped, stretched or redesigned.
Back views (N, NE, NW) show the real back: cloak/cape, back of the head/headwear, the weapon seen from behind and partly hidden by the body.
```

## ขั้น 3 — เดิน (`walk`) · 8 เฟรม · 8 ภาพ

**3.1 ทิศ S** → บันทึกเป็น `hawkeye_male_walk_S_raw_v1.png`

```text
Using the approved MASTER REFERENCE of Hawkeye (male) from earlier in this chat:
Make a sprite sheet of the WALK animation, direction S (facing the camera, front view).
DIRECTION LOCK: use the approved STANDING POSE for direction S from earlier in this chat as the exact facing, body angle, size and weapon/shield placement for every frame - do not reinterpret the direction.
Grid: 4 columns x 2 rows = 8 frames, equal cells 384x512, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Image size 1536x1024 landscape.
HARD RULE: this image shows ONLY direction S and ONLY the WALK animation - exactly 8 frames, nothing else. No other directions, no extra rows or columns, no 8x8 grid.
SPACING (hard rule): every figure stands alone in its own cell with EMPTY transparent space on ALL FOUR SIDES (top, bottom, left, right) of at least 20% of the cell; so the empty gap between two neighbouring figures is at least 40% of a cell width - TWICE the edge margin. Figures (including weapon, shield, cloak, wings and hair) never touch, never overlap and are never cut by the cell or image edge. Character height about 55-60% of the cell height.
NO BACKGROUND (hard rule): the background is fully TRANSPARENT (PNG alpha). No color, no gradient, no brown/grey/white backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow, no fog, no scenery.
Same character size and the same feet position in every frame. TRANSPARENT background (PNG with alpha), no backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow.
Hands: wooden longbow always in the character's LEFT hand; the RIGHT hand draws arrows from the quiver and pulls the string. Never swap. Do not mirror.
In direction S the character's RIGHT hand is on the IMAGE LEFT and the LEFT hand is on the IMAGE RIGHT; forward is toward the camera (down in the image).
Weapon direction: the LEFT hand holds the bow out in front, angled toward the camera (down in the image); when an arrow is drawn it points toward the camera (down in the image). The weapon turns with the body and keeps a clear gap from it (arm reaching out, never glued to the torso or legs) - but never swing it out sideways away from the facing direction and never switch sides.
Weapon shape: identical to the master reference 100% - rigid, never bent, warped, stretched or redesigned; a straight blade/shaft stays perfectly straight in every frame.
Motion: walking loop in place (the character does not travel across the cell): frame 1 left foot forward contact, 2 down, 3 passing, 4 up, 5 right foot forward contact, 6 down, 7 passing, 8 up. Legs clearly alternate, arms and cape counter-swing, small up-down body bob. Frame 8 must flow smoothly back into frame 1. Weapon pose: bow held low in the left hand tilted about 45 degrees downward toward the front, right hand relaxed near the hip. Arms reach out so the weapon and any shield/focus stay clear of the body with visible space between them.
```

## ขั้น 10 — สกิลรายตัว (ท่าของแต่ละสกิล + ภาพเอฟเฟกต์)

แต่ละสกิลมี 2 ส่วน: **A. ท่าตัวละคร** 8 ภาพ (1 ภาพ = 1 ทิศ) และ **B. ภาพเอฟเฟกต์** (สกิลที่พุ่ง/ฟันไปข้างหน้าทำ 8 ทิศ · สกิลวงกลม/บัฟทำ 1 ภาพ)

> เอฟเฟกต์ใช้ **พื้นดำล้วน #000000** (ไม่ใช่โปร่งใส) เพราะเกมนำไปบวกแสง สีดำจะหายไปเอง และต้องเว้นขอบดำ 15% ทุกด้าน ไม่ให้เห็นกรอบสี่เหลี่ยม

## ขั้น 0 — เปิดแชทใหม่ แนบ `STYLE_ANCHOR.png` แล้ววางข้อความนี้

```text
You are producing game sprite art for "SoulForge", a 2.5D dark-fantasy MMORPG. Follow these rules in EVERY image of this chat:

STYLE: DARK FANTASY / GRIMDARK hand-painted game art - NOT bright, NOT cute, NOT anime gacha, NOT glossy mobile-game style.
STYLE ANCHOR (the fixed look of the whole game; if a STYLE ANCHOR image is attached, match its style, rendering and tone (but use the more chibi proportions below) - but NOT its design, unless this chat is for that same character):
  - Proportions: CHIBI, about 2.5 heads tall (the head is about 40% of the total height) - MORE chibi than the STYLE ANCHOR image. Big head with a MATURE, grim adult face (never a baby face, never big sparkly eyes). Short compact torso, short thick arms and legs, oversized hands, boots, pauldrons and armor plates, wide grounded stance. Cute proportions, dark and serious mood.
  - Face: stern frown, narrow tired eyes with dark shadows under them, heavy brows, pale ashen skin, battle scars (for example a scar across one eye), messy hair.
  - Rendering: highly detailed hand-painted texture on every surface - hammered and pitted metal, rust spots, grime, frayed torn cloth, worn cracked leather, visible fine brushwork, crisp dark outline on the silhouette.
  - Lighting: dim warm light from the top-left, deep brown-black shadows, strong light/dark contrast; glow only on small holy or magic accents.
  - Palette: desaturated and dirty - tarnished bronze and antique gold, dark gunmetal steel, oxblood / dried-blood red cloth, bone-white aged parchment, dark leather browns. Never saturated, never bright.
  - Macabre relic details: torn parchment strips with red wax seals, chains, small crosses or class relics, a hanging lantern or charm, ghostly faces or motifs carved into gear - age, decay and sacrifice in every piece.
DARK & HAUNTED TONE (mandatory for EVERY image in this game - characters, monsters, bosses, NPCs, items, maps):
  - Low-key lighting: most of the figure sits in dark midtones and deep, almost black shadows; only the top-left lit edges and a few focal points (face, emblem, magic glow) are bright.
  - Muted, desaturated, dirty colors: tarnished antique gold (never bright yellow gold), dull scratched gunmetal steel (never shiny chrome), dark faded cloth, worn leather.
  - Wear and grime: scratches, dents, chipped edges, soot, mud on boots and hems, frayed and torn cloth edges.
  - Serious, grim, battle-hardened faces: smaller narrow eyes with heavy brows, no big sparkling anime eyes, no blush, no cute smile.
  - Heavy painterly brushwork with strong contrast between light and shadow.
  - HAUNTED, eerie undertone: a cold, sickly pale-teal or ghostly-green rim light on the shadow side; pale, slightly ashen skin; shadowed hollow eye areas; a quiet sense of dread.
  - Small macabre details that fit the class or creature: bone charms, skull motifs, chains, wax seals and dripping candle wax, stitched scars, cracked runes, torn prayer cloth, faint ghostly wisps clinging to cloth edges (on the figure only, never on the background).
  - Heroes are grim survivors in a cursed world - dark and haunted, but still heroic and readable, never gory.
CAMERA: fixed 3/4 top-down view, about 30 degrees above the horizon, orthographic (no perspective distortion). Same camera in every image.
LIGHT: key light from the TOP-LEFT of the image, warm; faint cool rim light on the right. NO cast shadow on the ground.
BACKGROUND: NO BACKGROUND. Output a PNG with a real TRANSPARENT background (alpha channel): only the character/object is visible, everything else is empty transparency.
  Never paint a checkerboard pattern, a white or grey backdrop, a floor, a ground shadow, a vignette or any scenery to "show" transparency.
  (Only if you are unable to output real transparency, use a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta instead - for purple characters #00FF00 green - with nothing else on it.)
FORBIDDEN: text, numbers, labels, grid lines, frames, borders, watermarks, UI, scenery, ground plane, more than one character per cell, mirrored copies.
OUTPUT FORMAT IS A HARD RULE (never break it):
  - ONE image = ONE action in ONE direction only. Never put several directions, several actions or a turnaround in the same image.
  - The image contains EXACTLY the number of frames and the exact grid I ask for (e.g. 4 columns x 2 rows = 8 frames) - never more cells, never fewer, never an 8x8 or any other grid.
  - The image is EXACTLY the size I ask for (1536x1024 or 1024x1024).
  - SPACING: every figure stands alone in its own cell with EMPTY transparent space on ALL FOUR SIDES (top, bottom, left, right) of at least 20% of the cell; so the empty gap between two neighbouring figures is at least 40% of a cell width - TWICE the edge margin. Figures (including weapon, shield, cloak, wings and hair) never touch, never overlap and are never cut by the cell or image edge. Character height about 55-60% of the cell height.
  - NO BACKGROUND: the background is fully TRANSPARENT (PNG alpha). No color, no gradient, no brown/grey/white backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow, no fog, no scenery.
  - If anything I ask would break these rules, do NOT draw - ask me instead.
SPRITE SHEETS: exactly the grid I ask for, equal cells, ONE pose per cell, the whole body and weapon fully inside each cell with empty space around it,
  same character size and the same feet position in every cell, feet near the bottom of each cell.
CONSISTENCY: the master reference you create in this chat is the law — same face, hair, armor pieces, colors, patterns, weapon shape and size. Never redesign.
HANDS: left/right always means the CHARACTER'S own left/right, not the image's. Never swap the hands of the weapon/shield/focus in any direction.
DIRECTIONS (image left/right):
  S = facing the camera, front view
  SE = three-quarter front, body turned toward the RIGHT side of the image
  E = full side profile facing the RIGHT edge of the image
  NE = three-quarter back view, facing away toward the upper RIGHT
  N = back view, facing away from the camera
  NW = three-quarter back view, facing away toward the upper LEFT
  W = full side profile facing the LEFT edge of the image
  SW = three-quarter front, body turned toward the LEFT side of the image
Back views (N, NE, NW) must show the real back: cape, back of helmet/hood, weapon seen from behind.
WEAPON HOLD (for clean animation): weapons, shields and focus items are held clearly AWAY from the body - the arm reaches out about 30-45 degrees, leaving visible empty space between the item and the torso, legs and face. The blade/shaft never lies flat against the body or crosses over the torso, face or the other arm in idle and walk; a shield is held slightly forward with a small gap, not glued to the chest. Body and weapon must read as two separate shapes in every direction and every frame.
WEAPON FOLLOWS THE BODY: weapons, shields and focus items turn together with the character. Whatever the direction, the weapon stays in the same hand and its tip/head points the same way the character is facing (unless the class rule says otherwise).
  In back views (N, NE, NW) the weapon in front of the body may be partly hidden by the body or seen from behind - that is correct. Never swing it out sideways or flip it to the other side just to make it visible.
WEAPON SHAPE IS FIXED: every weapon, shield and focus item is a rigid object that must match the master reference 100% in every frame and every direction - same shape, length, width, thickness, proportions, curve, details and colors. Blades, staffs, bows, hammers and shields NEVER bend, warp, wobble, melt, stretch, shrink, thicken, split or change design. Only perspective may change as the object turns (foreshortening), never its real shape. A straight blade stays perfectly straight.

The attached image is the STYLE ANCHOR of the whole game: match its face style, rendering, lighting, palette and grimdark tone exactly, but make the body MORE CHIBI than the anchor (about 2.5 heads tall). Do NOT copy its design, armor, colors or weapons - this chat is for a different character.

CHARACTER FOR THIS CHAT: RuneMaster (male), player class.

DARK PALETTE: black-navy and dark slate-teal coat, tarnished gold rune embroidery, dark leather; only the runes, blade edge and rune stone glow soft teal.
HAND RULE: rune sword with a glowing teal blade in the character's RIGHT hand; a glowing teal rune stone floating just above the open LEFT palm. Never swap.
DEFAULT POSE: sword pointing down-forward at the right side, left hand raised at waist-to-chest height with the rune stone hovering above the palm. Arms reach out so the weapon and any shield/focus stay clear of the body with visible space between them.
```

## ขั้น 1 — สร้างภาพต้นแบบ (Master Reference) · 1 ภาพ

```text
Create the MASTER REFERENCE of RuneMaster (male) now, exactly as described in LOOK, DARK PALETTE and HAND RULE. Design it from scratch in the exact style of the STYLE ANCHOR image.
Match the STYLE ANCHOR image and follow the DARK & HAUNTED rules strictly: low-key lighting with deep shadows, muted dirty colors, tarnished gold, worn scratched metal, grime, a grim serious face with narrow eyes. It must look like grimdark dark-fantasy game art, not a bright cute anime or gacha character.
Weapons, shields and headwear are rigid objects with clean, well-defined shapes; this design will be copied 100% in every later image.
ONE image, exactly 1536x1024 landscape, exactly THREE figures (no more): three views of the same character side by side, full body, same size, feet on the same horizontal line, standing in the idle pose (sword pointing down-forward at the right side, left hand raised at waist-to-chest height with the rune stone hovering above the palm. Arms reach out so the weapon and any shield/focus stay clear of the body with visible space between them):
left = S (facing the camera), middle = SW (three-quarter front, body turned toward the LEFT side of the image), right = N (back view, cloak/cape and the back of the headwear clearly visible).
SPACING (hard rule): each of the three figures sits in its own third of the image with empty transparent space of at least 20% of that third on all four sides; the gap between two figures is at least TWICE that edge margin. Nothing touches, overlaps or is cut by the edge.
TRANSPARENT background (PNG with alpha): no backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no frames.
```

1. ถ้าไม่ชอบ ตอบ `Redo` หรือบอกจุดที่ต้องแก้ (เช่น `Make the wings on the helmet bigger. Keep everything else.`) จนพอใจ
2. พอใจแล้วตอบในแชทว่า:
```text
This is the approved MASTER REFERENCE. From now on, every sprite sheet in this chat must match this image 100%: same face, hair, outfit, headwear, cloak, colors, and the exact same weapon and shield shapes.
```
3. ดาวน์โหลดภาพเก็บไว้เป็น `output\sprites-v4\master-refs\RuneMaster_male_master_ref_v2.png` และ**ส่งให้ผมดู** (แนะนำให้รอผมตอบก่อนเจนต่อ จะได้ไม่เสียแรงถ้าแบบต้องแก้)
4. ถ้าเจนไปหลายภาพแล้วตัวละครเริ่มเพี้ยน ให้แนบไฟล์ต้นแบบนี้กลับเข้าแชท แล้วพิมพ์ `Match this master reference exactly.`

## ขั้น 2 — ท่ายืนเริ่มต้นครบ 8 ทิศ (ภาพอ้างอิงทิศ) · 1 ภาพต่อทิศ · 8 ภาพ

> ทำต่อในแชทเดิมหลังต้นแบบผ่านแล้ว · ภาพชุดนี้คือ "ตัวล็อกทิศ" ทุกท่าในขั้นถัดไปจะอ้างอิงภาพยืนของทิศนั้น AI จึงไม่ต้องตีความทิศเอง · ถ้าภาพไหนผิด (มือสลับ ทิศผิด อาวุธชิดตัว หน้าตาเพี้ยน) **เจนใหม่จนถูกก่อน** ห้ามข้ามไปขั้น 3

**2.1 ทิศ S** → บันทึกเป็น `runemaster_male_stand_S_raw_v1.png`

```text
Using the approved MASTER REFERENCE of RuneMaster (male) from earlier in this chat:
Draw the DEFAULT STANDING POSE (one still idle frame) facing direction S (facing the camera, front view).
Do NOT invent anything: follow every rule already given in this chat - STYLE ANCHOR, chibi proportions, DARK & HAUNTED tone, HANDS, WEAPON HOLD, WEAPON FOLLOWS THE BODY, WEAPON SHAPE IS FIXED, the DIRECTIONS table, OUTPUT FORMAT and NO BACKGROUND. Same design, colours, headwear, cloak, weapon and shield shapes and the same body size as the master reference.
HARD RULE: ONE character only, facing ONLY direction S. No other views, no turnaround, no extra figures. Image exactly 1024x1024 square.
SPACING (hard rule): character height about 55-60% of the image, horizontally centred, feet at about 85% of the image height, at least 20% empty transparent space on all four sides; nothing cut by the edge.
NO BACKGROUND (hard rule): fully TRANSPARENT (PNG alpha) - no colour, gradient, checkerboard, floor, shadow or fog.
Pose: sword pointing down-forward at the right side, left hand raised at waist-to-chest height with the rune stone hovering above the palm. Arms reach out so the weapon and any shield/focus stay clear of the body with visible space between them.
Hands: rune sword with a glowing teal blade in the character's RIGHT hand; a glowing teal rune stone floating just above the open LEFT palm. Never swap. Do not mirror.
In direction S the character's RIGHT hand is on the IMAGE LEFT and the LEFT hand is on the IMAGE RIGHT; forward is toward the camera (down in the image).
Weapon direction: the RIGHT hand holds the sword with its tip angled toward the camera (down in the image), down-forward; the rune stone above the LEFT palm is held out toward the camera (down in the image). The weapon turns with the body and keeps a clear gap from it (arm reaching out, never glued to the torso or legs) - but never swing it out sideways away from the facing direction and never switch sides.
Weapon shape: identical to the master reference 100% - rigid, never bent, warped, stretched or redesigned.
Back views (N, NE, NW) show the real back: cloak/cape, back of the head/headwear, the weapon seen from behind and partly hidden by the body.
```

## ขั้น 3 — เดิน (`walk`) · 8 เฟรม · 8 ภาพ

**3.1 ทิศ S** → บันทึกเป็น `runemaster_male_walk_S_raw_v1.png`

```text
Using the approved MASTER REFERENCE of RuneMaster (male) from earlier in this chat:
Make a sprite sheet of the WALK animation, direction S (facing the camera, front view).
DIRECTION LOCK: use the approved STANDING POSE for direction S from earlier in this chat as the exact facing, body angle, size and weapon/shield placement for every frame - do not reinterpret the direction.
Grid: 4 columns x 2 rows = 8 frames, equal cells 384x512, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Image size 1536x1024 landscape.
HARD RULE: this image shows ONLY direction S and ONLY the WALK animation - exactly 8 frames, nothing else. No other directions, no extra rows or columns, no 8x8 grid.
SPACING (hard rule): every figure stands alone in its own cell with EMPTY transparent space on ALL FOUR SIDES (top, bottom, left, right) of at least 20% of the cell; so the empty gap between two neighbouring figures is at least 40% of a cell width - TWICE the edge margin. Figures (including weapon, shield, cloak, wings and hair) never touch, never overlap and are never cut by the cell or image edge. Character height about 55-60% of the cell height.
NO BACKGROUND (hard rule): the background is fully TRANSPARENT (PNG alpha). No color, no gradient, no brown/grey/white backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow, no fog, no scenery.
Same character size and the same feet position in every frame. TRANSPARENT background (PNG with alpha), no backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow.
Hands: rune sword with a glowing teal blade in the character's RIGHT hand; a glowing teal rune stone floating just above the open LEFT palm. Never swap. Do not mirror.
In direction S the character's RIGHT hand is on the IMAGE LEFT and the LEFT hand is on the IMAGE RIGHT; forward is toward the camera (down in the image).
Weapon direction: the RIGHT hand holds the sword with its tip angled toward the camera (down in the image), down-forward; the rune stone above the LEFT palm is held out toward the camera (down in the image). The weapon turns with the body and keeps a clear gap from it (arm reaching out, never glued to the torso or legs) - but never swing it out sideways away from the facing direction and never switch sides.
Weapon shape: identical to the master reference 100% - rigid, never bent, warped, stretched or redesigned; a straight blade/shaft stays perfectly straight in every frame.
Motion: walking loop in place (the character does not travel across the cell): frame 1 left foot forward contact, 2 down, 3 passing, 4 up, 5 right foot forward contact, 6 down, 7 passing, 8 up. Legs clearly alternate, arms and cape counter-swing, small up-down body bob. Frame 8 must flow smoothly back into frame 1. Weapon pose: sword pointing down-forward at the right side, left hand raised at waist-to-chest height with the rune stone hovering above the palm. Arms reach out so the weapon and any shield/focus stay clear of the body with visible space between them.
```

## ขั้น 0 — เปิดแชทใหม่ แนบ `STYLE_ANCHOR.png` แล้ววางข้อความนี้

```text
You are producing game sprite art for "SoulForge", a 2.5D dark-fantasy MMORPG. Follow these rules in EVERY image of this chat:

STYLE: DARK FANTASY / GRIMDARK hand-painted game art - NOT bright, NOT cute, NOT anime gacha, NOT glossy mobile-game style.
STYLE ANCHOR (the fixed look of the whole game; if a STYLE ANCHOR image is attached, match its style, rendering and tone (but use the more chibi proportions below) - but NOT its design, unless this chat is for that same character):
  - Proportions: CHIBI, about 2.5 heads tall (the head is about 40% of the total height) - MORE chibi than the STYLE ANCHOR image. Big head with a MATURE, grim adult face (never a baby face, never big sparkly eyes). Short compact torso, short thick arms and legs, oversized hands, boots, pauldrons and armor plates, wide grounded stance. Cute proportions, dark and serious mood.
  - Face: stern frown, narrow tired eyes with dark shadows under them, heavy brows, pale ashen skin, battle scars (for example a scar across one eye), messy hair.
  - Rendering: highly detailed hand-painted texture on every surface - hammered and pitted metal, rust spots, grime, frayed torn cloth, worn cracked leather, visible fine brushwork, crisp dark outline on the silhouette.
  - Lighting: dim warm light from the top-left, deep brown-black shadows, strong light/dark contrast; glow only on small holy or magic accents.
  - Palette: desaturated and dirty - tarnished bronze and antique gold, dark gunmetal steel, oxblood / dried-blood red cloth, bone-white aged parchment, dark leather browns. Never saturated, never bright.
  - Macabre relic details: torn parchment strips with red wax seals, chains, small crosses or class relics, a hanging lantern or charm, ghostly faces or motifs carved into gear - age, decay and sacrifice in every piece.
DARK & HAUNTED TONE (mandatory for EVERY image in this game - characters, monsters, bosses, NPCs, items, maps):
  - Low-key lighting: most of the figure sits in dark midtones and deep, almost black shadows; only the top-left lit edges and a few focal points (face, emblem, magic glow) are bright.
  - Muted, desaturated, dirty colors: tarnished antique gold (never bright yellow gold), dull scratched gunmetal steel (never shiny chrome), dark faded cloth, worn leather.
  - Wear and grime: scratches, dents, chipped edges, soot, mud on boots and hems, frayed and torn cloth edges.
  - Serious, grim, battle-hardened faces: smaller narrow eyes with heavy brows, no big sparkling anime eyes, no blush, no cute smile.
  - Heavy painterly brushwork with strong contrast between light and shadow.
  - HAUNTED, eerie undertone: a cold, sickly pale-teal or ghostly-green rim light on the shadow side; pale, slightly ashen skin; shadowed hollow eye areas; a quiet sense of dread.
  - Small macabre details that fit the class or creature: bone charms, skull motifs, chains, wax seals and dripping candle wax, stitched scars, cracked runes, torn prayer cloth, faint ghostly wisps clinging to cloth edges (on the figure only, never on the background).
  - Heroes are grim survivors in a cursed world - dark and haunted, but still heroic and readable, never gory.
CAMERA: fixed 3/4 top-down view, about 30 degrees above the horizon, orthographic (no perspective distortion). Same camera in every image.
LIGHT: key light from the TOP-LEFT of the image, warm; faint cool rim light on the right. NO cast shadow on the ground.
BACKGROUND: NO BACKGROUND. Output a PNG with a real TRANSPARENT background (alpha channel): only the character/object is visible, everything else is empty transparency.
  Never paint a checkerboard pattern, a white or grey backdrop, a floor, a ground shadow, a vignette or any scenery to "show" transparency.
  (Only if you are unable to output real transparency, use a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta instead - for purple characters #00FF00 green - with nothing else on it.)
FORBIDDEN: text, numbers, labels, grid lines, frames, borders, watermarks, UI, scenery, ground plane, more than one character per cell, mirrored copies.
OUTPUT FORMAT IS A HARD RULE (never break it):
  - ONE image = ONE action in ONE direction only. Never put several directions, several actions or a turnaround in the same image.
  - The image contains EXACTLY the number of frames and the exact grid I ask for (e.g. 4 columns x 2 rows = 8 frames) - never more cells, never fewer, never an 8x8 or any other grid.
  - The image is EXACTLY the size I ask for (1536x1024 or 1024x1024).
  - SPACING: every figure stands alone in its own cell with EMPTY transparent space on ALL FOUR SIDES (top, bottom, left, right) of at least 20% of the cell; so the empty gap between two neighbouring figures is at least 40% of a cell width - TWICE the edge margin. Figures (including weapon, shield, cloak, wings and hair) never touch, never overlap and are never cut by the cell or image edge. Character height about 55-60% of the cell height.
  - NO BACKGROUND: the background is fully TRANSPARENT (PNG alpha). No color, no gradient, no brown/grey/white backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow, no fog, no scenery.
  - If anything I ask would break these rules, do NOT draw - ask me instead.
SPRITE SHEETS: exactly the grid I ask for, equal cells, ONE pose per cell, the whole body and weapon fully inside each cell with empty space around it,
  same character size and the same feet position in every cell, feet near the bottom of each cell.
CONSISTENCY: the master reference you create in this chat is the law — same face, hair, armor pieces, colors, patterns, weapon shape and size. Never redesign.
HANDS: left/right always means the CHARACTER'S own left/right, not the image's. Never swap the hands of the weapon/shield/focus in any direction.
DIRECTIONS (image left/right):
  S = facing the camera, front view
  SE = three-quarter front, body turned toward the RIGHT side of the image
  E = full side profile facing the RIGHT edge of the image
  NE = three-quarter back view, facing away toward the upper RIGHT
  N = back view, facing away from the camera
  NW = three-quarter back view, facing away toward the upper LEFT
  W = full side profile facing the LEFT edge of the image
  SW = three-quarter front, body turned toward the LEFT side of the image
Back views (N, NE, NW) must show the real back: cape, back of helmet/hood, weapon seen from behind.
WEAPON HOLD (for clean animation): weapons, shields and focus items are held clearly AWAY from the body - the arm reaches out about 30-45 degrees, leaving visible empty space between the item and the torso, legs and face. The blade/shaft never lies flat against the body or crosses over the torso, face or the other arm in idle and walk; a shield is held slightly forward with a small gap, not glued to the chest. Body and weapon must read as two separate shapes in every direction and every frame.
WEAPON FOLLOWS THE BODY: weapons, shields and focus items turn together with the character. Whatever the direction, the weapon stays in the same hand and its tip/head points the same way the character is facing (unless the class rule says otherwise).
  In back views (N, NE, NW) the weapon in front of the body may be partly hidden by the body or seen from behind - that is correct. Never swing it out sideways or flip it to the other side just to make it visible.
WEAPON SHAPE IS FIXED: every weapon, shield and focus item is a rigid object that must match the master reference 100% in every frame and every direction - same shape, length, width, thickness, proportions, curve, details and colors. Blades, staffs, bows, hammers and shields NEVER bend, warp, wobble, melt, stretch, shrink, thicken, split or change design. Only perspective may change as the object turns (foreshortening), never its real shape. A straight blade stays perfectly straight.
This character uses purple: if real transparency is impossible, the fallback color in THIS chat is flat #00FF00 green, never magenta.

The attached image is the STYLE ANCHOR of the whole game: match its face style, rendering, lighting, palette and grimdark tone exactly, but make the body MORE CHIBI than the anchor (about 2.5 heads tall). Do NOT copy its design, armor, colors or weapons - this chat is for a different character.

CHARACTER FOR THIS CHAT: Elementalist (male), player class.
LOOK: Grim chibi young mage with messy dark-purple hair and violet eyes, layered dark-purple tattered cloak with high collar and gold trim, dark clothes underneath, black boots. Long ornate staff topped with a large blue crystal wreathed in small orange-and-blue magic flames.
DARK PALETTE: deep plum-black and dark violet robes, tarnished gold trim, black boots; only the staff crystal glows (blue and ember orange).
HAND RULE: the staff is held in the character's RIGHT hand when standing; when walking both hands hold it (LEFT hand higher, RIGHT hand lower). Never swap.
DEFAULT POSE: idle: staff perfectly vertical in the right hand, crystal pointing up, bottom tip on the ground. Walk: staff held across the body with both hands, tilted 45 degrees; the robe hem swings so the boot tips show on each step. Arms reach out so the weapon and any shield/focus stay clear of the body with visible space between them.
Do not draw anything yet. Reply only with a short confirmation that you understand the character and the rules.
```

## ขั้น 10 — สกิลรายตัว (ท่าของแต่ละสกิล + ภาพเอฟเฟกต์)

แต่ละสกิลมี 2 ส่วน: **A. ท่าตัวละคร** 8 ภาพ (1 ภาพ = 1 ทิศ) และ **B. ภาพเอฟเฟกต์** (สกิลที่พุ่ง/ฟันไปข้างหน้าทำ 8 ทิศ · สกิลวงกลม/บัฟทำ 1 ภาพ)

> เอฟเฟกต์ใช้ **พื้นดำล้วน #000000** (ไม่ใช่โปร่งใส) เพราะเกมนำไปบวกแสง สีดำจะหายไปเอง และต้องเว้นขอบดำ 15% ทุกด้าน ไม่ให้เห็นกรอบสี่เหลี่ยม

**10.4.A1 ทิศ S** → บันทึกเป็น `elementalist_male_skill-e-frost-nova_S_raw_v1.png`

```text
Using the approved MASTER REFERENCE of Elementalist (male) from earlier in this chat:
Make a sprite sheet of the SKILL "Frost Nova" animation, direction S (facing the camera, front view).
DIRECTION LOCK: use the approved STANDING POSE for direction S from earlier in this chat as the exact facing, body angle, size and weapon/shield placement for every frame - do not reinterpret the direction. The skill is aimed toward the camera (down in the image) (the facing direction).
Grid: 4 columns x 2 rows = 8 frames, equal cells 384x512, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Image size 1536x1024 landscape.
HARD RULE: this image shows ONLY direction S and ONLY the "Frost Nova" animation - exactly 8 frames, nothing else. No other directions, no extra rows or columns, no 8x8 grid.
SPACING (hard rule): every figure stands alone in its own cell with EMPTY transparent space on ALL FOUR SIDES of at least 20% of the cell; the gap between two neighbouring figures is at least 40% of a cell width - TWICE the edge margin. NO BACKGROUND (hard rule): fully TRANSPARENT (PNG alpha). No colour, gradient, backdrop, checkerboard, floor, shadow, fog or scenery.
Same character size and the same feet position in every frame (a dash or leap may move the body inside the cell but never out of it).
Hands: the staff is held in the character's RIGHT hand when standing; when walking both hands hold it (LEFT hand higher, RIGHT hand lower). Never swap. Do not mirror.
In direction S the character's RIGHT hand is on the IMAGE LEFT and the LEFT hand is on the IMAGE RIGHT; forward is toward the camera (down in the image).
Weapon direction: the staff stays in the RIGHT hand (both hands when walking) and its crystal head leans slightly toward the camera (down in the image); when casting it points toward the camera (down in the image). The weapon turns with the body and keeps a clear gap from it - every strike, thrust or shot goes toward the camera (down in the image), never sideways and never backward; never switch hands.
Weapon shape: identical to the master reference 100% - rigid, never bent, warped, stretched or redesigned.
Motion: frames 1-3 lift the staff, 4-5 slam its bottom tip into the ground, 6-8 kneel as the cold spreads, then stand.
Draw NO magic, light, smoke, sparks or impact effects - the body animation only (the effect is a separate sheet).
```

```text
Make an EFFECT-ONLY sprite sheet for the Elementalist skill "Cataclysm" - NO character, NO weapon, NO hands, NO body.
Grid: 3 columns x 2 rows = 6 frames, equal cells 512x512, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Image size 1536x1024 landscape.
```

```text
BACKGROUND (hard rule for effects): pure flat BLACK #000000 everywhere - the game adds this sheet as light, so black becomes invisible. No gradient, no vignette, no grey haze, no glow, smoke or particles reaching the cell edges: keep at least 15% pure black margin on ALL FOUR SIDES of every cell, so no frame ever shows a square box.
Style: match the STYLE ANCHOR - DARK & HAUNTED painted VFX, smoky, ghostly, desaturated, never bright cartoon or neon. Colours: dark orange fire, pale-blue frost and violet lightning.
View: lying FLAT on the ground, seen from the game camera (three-quarter top-down, about 50 degrees) so a circle reads as a wide ellipse.
Effect: fire, frost and lightning slamming together into a 4 m circle in three waves, smoke and ice shards.
Timing: frames 1-2 build up, 3-4 peak (largest and brightest), 5-6 fade and break apart into smoke.
No direction: the effect is round / symmetric so one sheet serves all 8 facings.
```

# 5. Assassin — แอสแซสซิน · prompt ทีละขั้น (ชาย)

ต้นแบบ: สร้างใหม่ใน**ขั้น 1** (แนบแค่ `STYLE_ANCHOR.png` ในขั้น 0) · **ไม่มีพื้นหลัง (โปร่งใส)** — สำรอง #00FF00

บันทึกไฟล์ที่: `output\sprites-v4\assassin\` · ต้นแบบบันทึกที่ `output\sprites-v4\master-refs\Assassin_male_master_ref_v2.png`

> ทำทุกขั้นใน **แชทเดียวกัน** · ไฟล์เดียวที่ต้องแนบคือ **`master-refs\STYLE_ANCHOR.png`** ในขั้น 0 (ภาพแบบสไตล์/โทนของทั้งเกม) ต้นแบบที่ AI สร้างในขั้น 1 จะอยู่ในแชทนั้น ทุกกล่องหลังจากนั้นอ้างถึงภาพนี้เอง

## ขั้น 0 — เปิดแชทใหม่ แนบ `STYLE_ANCHOR.png` แล้ววางข้อความนี้

```text
You are producing game sprite art for "SoulForge", a 2.5D dark-fantasy MMORPG. Follow these rules in EVERY image of this chat:

STYLE: DARK FANTASY / GRIMDARK hand-painted game art - NOT bright, NOT cute, NOT anime gacha, NOT glossy mobile-game style.
STYLE ANCHOR (the fixed look of the whole game; if a STYLE ANCHOR image is attached, match its style, rendering and tone (but use the more chibi proportions below) - but NOT its design, unless this chat is for that same character):
  - Proportions: CHIBI, about 2.5 heads tall (the head is about 40% of the total height) - MORE chibi than the STYLE ANCHOR image. Big head with a MATURE, grim adult face (never a baby face, never big sparkly eyes). Short compact torso, short thick arms and legs, oversized hands, boots, pauldrons and armor plates, wide grounded stance. Cute proportions, dark and serious mood.
  - Face: stern frown, narrow tired eyes with dark shadows under them, heavy brows, pale ashen skin, battle scars (for example a scar across one eye), messy hair.
  - Rendering: highly detailed hand-painted texture on every surface - hammered and pitted metal, rust spots, grime, frayed torn cloth, worn cracked leather, visible fine brushwork, crisp dark outline on the silhouette.
  - Lighting: dim warm light from the top-left, deep brown-black shadows, strong light/dark contrast; glow only on small holy or magic accents.
  - Palette: desaturated and dirty - tarnished bronze and antique gold, dark gunmetal steel, oxblood / dried-blood red cloth, bone-white aged parchment, dark leather browns. Never saturated, never bright.
  - Macabre relic details: torn parchment strips with red wax seals, chains, small crosses or class relics, a hanging lantern or charm, ghostly faces or motifs carved into gear - age, decay and sacrifice in every piece.
DARK & HAUNTED TONE (mandatory for EVERY image in this game - characters, monsters, bosses, NPCs, items, maps):
  - Low-key lighting: most of the figure sits in dark midtones and deep, almost black shadows; only the top-left lit edges and a few focal points (face, emblem, magic glow) are bright.
  - Muted, desaturated, dirty colors: tarnished antique gold (never bright yellow gold), dull scratched gunmetal steel (never shiny chrome), dark faded cloth, worn leather.
  - Wear and grime: scratches, dents, chipped edges, soot, mud on boots and hems, frayed and torn cloth edges.
  - Serious, grim, battle-hardened faces: smaller narrow eyes with heavy brows, no big sparkling anime eyes, no blush, no cute smile.
  - Heavy painterly brushwork with strong contrast between light and shadow.
  - HAUNTED, eerie undertone: a cold, sickly pale-teal or ghostly-green rim light on the shadow side; pale, slightly ashen skin; shadowed hollow eye areas; a quiet sense of dread.
  - Small macabre details that fit the class or creature: bone charms, skull motifs, chains, wax seals and dripping candle wax, stitched scars, cracked runes, torn prayer cloth, faint ghostly wisps clinging to cloth edges (on the figure only, never on the background).
  - Heroes are grim survivors in a cursed world - dark and haunted, but still heroic and readable, never gory.
CAMERA: fixed 3/4 top-down view, about 30 degrees above the horizon, orthographic (no perspective distortion). Same camera in every image.
LIGHT: key light from the TOP-LEFT of the image, warm; faint cool rim light on the right. NO cast shadow on the ground.
BACKGROUND: NO BACKGROUND. Output a PNG with a real TRANSPARENT background (alpha channel): only the character/object is visible, everything else is empty transparency.
  Never paint a checkerboard pattern, a white or grey backdrop, a floor, a ground shadow, a vignette or any scenery to "show" transparency.
  (Only if you are unable to output real transparency, use a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF magenta instead - for purple characters #00FF00 green - with nothing else on it.)
FORBIDDEN: text, numbers, labels, grid lines, frames, borders, watermarks, UI, scenery, ground plane, more than one character per cell, mirrored copies.
OUTPUT FORMAT IS A HARD RULE (never break it):
  - ONE image = ONE action in ONE direction only. Never put several directions, several actions or a turnaround in the same image.
  - The image contains EXACTLY the number of frames and the exact grid I ask for (e.g. 4 columns x 2 rows = 8 frames) - never more cells, never fewer, never an 8x8 or any other grid.
  - The image is EXACTLY the size I ask for (1536x1024 or 1024x1024).
  - SPACING: every figure stands alone in its own cell with EMPTY transparent space on ALL FOUR SIDES (top, bottom, left, right) of at least 20% of the cell; so the empty gap between two neighbouring figures is at least 40% of a cell width - TWICE the edge margin. Figures (including weapon, shield, cloak, wings and hair) never touch, never overlap and are never cut by the cell or image edge. Character height about 55-60% of the cell height.
  - NO BACKGROUND: the background is fully TRANSPARENT (PNG alpha). No color, no gradient, no brown/grey/white backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow, no fog, no scenery.
  - If anything I ask would break these rules, do NOT draw - ask me instead.
SPRITE SHEETS: exactly the grid I ask for, equal cells, ONE pose per cell, the whole body and weapon fully inside each cell with empty space around it,
  same character size and the same feet position in every cell, feet near the bottom of each cell.
CONSISTENCY: the master reference you create in this chat is the law — same face, hair, armor pieces, colors, patterns, weapon shape and size. Never redesign.
HANDS: left/right always means the CHARACTER'S own left/right, not the image's. Never swap the hands of the weapon/shield/focus in any direction.
DIRECTIONS (image left/right):
  S = facing the camera, front view
  SE = three-quarter front, body turned toward the RIGHT side of the image
  E = full side profile facing the RIGHT edge of the image
  NE = three-quarter back view, facing away toward the upper RIGHT
  N = back view, facing away from the camera
  NW = three-quarter back view, facing away toward the upper LEFT
  W = full side profile facing the LEFT edge of the image
  SW = three-quarter front, body turned toward the LEFT side of the image
Back views (N, NE, NW) must show the real back: cape, back of helmet/hood, weapon seen from behind.
WEAPON HOLD (for clean animation): weapons, shields and focus items are held clearly AWAY from the body - the arm reaches out about 30-45 degrees, leaving visible empty space between the item and the torso, legs and face. The blade/shaft never lies flat against the body or crosses over the torso, face or the other arm in idle and walk; a shield is held slightly forward with a small gap, not glued to the chest. Body and weapon must read as two separate shapes in every direction and every frame.
WEAPON FOLLOWS THE BODY: weapons, shields and focus items turn together with the character. Whatever the direction, the weapon stays in the same hand and its tip/head points the same way the character is facing (unless the class rule says otherwise).
  In back views (N, NE, NW) the weapon in front of the body may be partly hidden by the body or seen from behind - that is correct. Never swing it out sideways or flip it to the other side just to make it visible.
WEAPON SHAPE IS FIXED: every weapon, shield and focus item is a rigid object that must match the master reference 100% in every frame and every direction - same shape, length, width, thickness, proportions, curve, details and colors. Blades, staffs, bows, hammers and shields NEVER bend, warp, wobble, melt, stretch, shrink, thicken, split or change design. Only perspective may change as the object turns (foreshortening), never its real shape. A straight blade stays perfectly straight.
This character uses purple: if real transparency is impossible, the fallback color in THIS chat is flat #00FF00 green, never magenta.

The attached image is the STYLE ANCHOR of the whole game: match its face style, rendering, lighting, palette and grimdark tone exactly, but make the body MORE CHIBI than the anchor (about 2.5 heads tall). Do NOT copy its design, armor, colors or weapons - this chat is for a different character.

CHARACTER FOR THIS CHAT: Assassin (male), player class.
LOOK: Grim chibi assassin in a black hood with dark purple lining, black cloth mask over the lower face with only violet eyes visible. Short ragged black cloak with dark purple lining attached to the hood, from the shoulders to mid-thigh, torn and split at the hem. Black leather and dark-metal light armor with many straps and buckles, purple sash at the waist, black boots.
DARK PALETTE: black and charcoal, very dark violet lining, blackened dull steel daggers and buckles, faded purple sash.
HAND RULE: one curved dagger in EACH hand, held in reverse grip, blades pointing down. Both daggers always present.
DEFAULT POSE: crouched ready stance, knees bent, both daggers held low at the sides. Arms reach out so the weapon and any shield/focus stay clear of the body with visible space between them.
Do not draw anything yet. Reply only with a short confirmation that you understand the character and the rules.
```

## ขั้น 10 — สกิลรายตัว (ท่าของแต่ละสกิล + ภาพเอฟเฟกต์)

แต่ละสกิลมี 2 ส่วน: **A. ท่าตัวละคร** 8 ภาพ (1 ภาพ = 1 ทิศ) และ **B. ภาพเอฟเฟกต์** (สกิลที่พุ่ง/ฟันไปข้างหน้าทำ 8 ทิศ · สกิลวงกลม/บัฟทำ 1 ภาพ)

> เอฟเฟกต์ใช้ **พื้นดำล้วน #000000** (ไม่ใช่โปร่งใส) เพราะเกมนำไปบวกแสง สีดำจะหายไปเอง และต้องเว้นขอบดำ 15% ทุกด้าน ไม่ให้เห็นกรอบสี่เหลี่ยม
